steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: DNA: antiparallel strands, complementary base pairing (A-T, G-C), sugar-phosphate backbone; Replication: helicase, DNA polymerase, Okazaki fragments, ligase

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Transcription: RNA pol, promoter, mRNA; Translation: tRNA, ribosome, codon-anticodon, start/stop codons; Eukaryotes: splicing (introns/exons), 5' cap, poly-A tail

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Mendel: segregation, independent assortment; Punnett squares; Test cross: unknown x homozygous recessive

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Linkage: genes on same chromosome; recombination frequency ∝ distance; Epistasis: one gene masks another (e.g. 9:3:4, 12:3:1, 9:7 ratios)

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: In sweet peas, flower colour is controlled by two genes (C and P). Both dominant alleles needed for purple flowers. Cross CcPp x CcPp. Find phenotypic ratio --- Solution: Both genes needed for purple. C_P_ = purple (9/16); ccP_ = white (3/16); C_pp = white (3/16); ccpp = white (1/16). Ratio = 9 purple : 7 white (complementary epistasis)

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Describe semi-conservative replication | A cross gives 9:3:3:1. What does this indicate? | Chi-squared test: observed 52:18, expected 3:1 ratio. Calculate χ^2
